snippet.title: Falling Apart │A First Look HiKing Mind's New Game
snippet.description:
We’re excited to officially reveal that we are once more collaborating with the talented team at HiKing Mind Studio to publish their new game, 🌀 Falling Apart 🌀

Enter the shattered mind of a man haunted by his past, explore his decaying inner world where fractured memories take physical form. Try to let go in this disturbing point-&-click puzzle adventure!

🧠 Wishlist Falling Apart now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4577070/Falling_Apart/ 

 Fall deeper in the trance by visiting www.secondmaze.com 🪱
